candidates.extracted_text: Item 1. Business Domino's Pizza, Inc. (DPZ) is a registrant under the Securities Exchange Act. Domino's franchises and operates pizza delivery and carryout restaurants. The system is heavily franchised and includes supply-chain operations supporting franchisees. Principal operations: Domino's Pizza, Inc.. Reported segments include: U.S. stores (52% of revenue); International franchise (30% of revenue); Supply chain (18% of revenue). As of year end, approximately 98% of system restaurants were franchised and the remainder were company-operated.
